meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置并校验计算流体仿真,让模拟稳定可靠、安全续跑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用计算流体仿真做科研数值模拟,需要确认设置准确并安全重启任务
copy.tagline_en: Set up and validate fluid-flow simulations for stable, safe runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run computational fluid dynamics simulations and need sound setup and safe restarts

howto.what: 当你提出流体模拟需求(如湍流、洋流)时,Claude 会指导你配置 FluidSim:选求解器、设网格与物理参数、启动计算并分析输出,产出脚本和图表;也会做数值有效性与 HPC 安全校验。
howto.when: 当你需要规划或分析 FluidSim 模拟时触发,比如选择求解器、检查参数、配置 FFT/MPI 等;也适用于 2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯、浅水方程、分层流等场景。

say.text: 我想跑 2D 湍流,用 ns2d,帮我设网格和粘度并生成运行代码。
say.note: Claude 会给出可运行的参数配置和操作步骤。

say.text: 帮我检查这组 FluidSim 参数是否数值稳定、在 HPC 上有没有风险。
say.note: Claude 按技能逐项做数值与安全校验并提建议。

say.text: 如何续跑上次中断的 ns3d 模拟?
say.note: Claude 说明重启前提与续跑步骤。

howto.what_en: When you ask about fluid-dynamics simulations, Claude configures FluidSim (solver, grid, parameters, run), analyzes outputs, and produces scripts/plots; it checks numerical validity and HPC safety.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning/analyzing FluidSim simulations, e.g., solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, etc.; also for 2D/3D Navier-Stokes, shallow-water, or stratified-flow scenarios.

say_en.text: Run 2D turbulence in ns2d: set grid and viscosity, give runnable code.
say_en.note: Claude gives runnable settings and steps.

say_en.text: Check my FluidSim parameters for numerical stability and HPC safety.
say_en.note: Applies the checks and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: How do I resume the interrupted ns3d simulation?
